title: Jellyfish Lake aerial, focus on jellyfish.jpg
author: Lukas
credit: originally posted to Flickr as Palau_2008030818_4737
description: Jellyfish Lake, with a focus on its east end. The numerous bright dots visible on and below the surface of the lake are the millions of jellyfish that inhabit its waters, which migrated to the eastern end of the lake during morning hours.
